verdict.rationale: AWS documents a single CLI covering multiple services with console-equivalent functionality and built-in documentation prompts (aws-docs-1, aws-docs-42, aws-docs-4). A non-flagship service, Cost Explorer, has its own API Reference (aws-docs-16), and the docs site exposes structured service-wide and per-service llms.txt indexes (aws-probe-1, aws-docs-49). However, nothing in the pack shows that every service has a complete, consistent API/CLI reference, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (aws-probe-3). Missing for 10: evidence of reference coverage across every service, evidence of a consistent reference format platform-wide, per-service CLI command reference pages, independent corroboration of reference quality and completeness.
